name: Angus Tuirmech
text: Angus Tuirmech, also known as Tuirmheach, was the incestuous father of Fiachu Per Mara. MacKillop gives the sense of his name as prolific or famous, with neither reading fixed. He stands at the edge of the early Irish family lists.

attributes.attribute: incestuous father of Fiachu Per Mara
